_comment: Crew content. Skills are declared here, not in C#: each one names a lever the simulation already has, and 'maxEffect' is what that lever gives at maxSkill. A skill with lever 'none' is carried, paid for and displayed but does nothing yet - that is how a future stat gets introduced before the system behind it exists.

skills.name: Navigation
skills.blurb: Reads the road. Raises convoy speed, which only pays when it saves a whole day.

skills.name: Negotiation
skills.blurb: Argues the buy price down. Erodes the market's cut on everything you purchase.

skills.name: Sales
skills.blurb: Argues the sale price up. Erodes the market's cut on everything you unload.

skills.name: Accounting
skills.blurb: Runs the books. Cuts truck upkeep and fuel; worth more the bigger the convoy.

_affinityComment: A city's industries shape who walks into its recruitment centre. Trade hubs breed talkers; refineries and plants breed bookkeepers.
